verdict.rationale: Vapi is a voice-agent platform whose assistants call tools, so consuming tools from external MCP servers is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence covers only the opposite direction: an official Vapi MCP Server that exposes Vapi's own APIs to MCP clients such as Claude Desktop. It also documents custom webhook/function tools and Make/GHL imports, but nothing shows assistants connecting to third-party MCP servers.
